items.title: Revolution Medicines Wins FDA Approval for Pancreatic Cancer Pill. What It Means for the Stock.
items.summary: Daraxonrasib, the pill touted by a former member of Congress and cancer patient as a ‘miracle drug,’ has been granted approval in patients with pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

items.title: Nvidia, Meta, Revolution Medicines, Abercrombie, Intuit, Salesforce, Moderna, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Stocks traded modestly lower Wednesday ahead of Nvidia’s earnings report and after the personal consumption expenditures index, or PCE, for July revealed inflation was a bit stronger than expected.  Nvidia   earnings after the bell could be key in determining where the artificial-intelligence trade goes next.  Intel  slipped 0.1% and  Broadcom  declined 0.9% with investors in wait-and-see mode when it comes to chip stocks.

items.title: Energy, Industrials, and Utilities Are Leading the Stock Market
items.summary: With the market in a holding pattern ahead of Nvidia’s earnings report, industrials, energy, and utilities were doing the heavy lifting. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 156 points, or 0.3%. The S&P 500 was down 0.

items.title: Moderna Drops 7% Despite a Fresh Wolfe Research Upgrade, BioNTech Slips
items.summary: Moderna stock shed 7% on Wednesday with no company news to blame, reopening a brutal question that its 439% year-to-date rally had been drowning out: what exactly does a $59 billion valuation buy on a revenue base this thin?

items.title: Moderna Stock Carries A Market Value Its Revenue Does Not Support
items.summary: Moderna's commercial business has shrunk and is lossmaking, which puts the weight of its market value on a pipeline rather than on revenue.

items.title: Merck Stock Hits New 52-Week High: What's Driving the Rally?
